Description: TC-001 | Verify UI Element Visibility | Navigate to the UI and check if all elements (sdada, sda, dsad, dsadasd, dsad) are visible | Elements should be visible | Functional Test
TC-002 | Verify UI Element Count | Check the count of UI elements (sdada, sda, dsad, dsanasd, dsad) | There should be 5 elements | Functional Test

TC-003 | Validate Text Content | Check if the text content of all UI elements matches with sdada, sda, dsad, dsanasd, dsad respectively | Each element's text should match its expected value | Functional Test

TC-004 | Verify Element Spacing and Alignment | Check the spacing between elements and alignment of elements within the UI | Spacing and alignment should be consistent as per design guidelines | Functional Test

TC-005 | Validate Click Event on Empty Space | Click on an empty space outside of the UI elements and verify no action is taken | No action should occur after clicking on an empty space | Functional Test

TC-006 | Verify Keyboard Input Focus | Navigate to the UI and check if keyboard input focus is set correctly on the first element (sdada) | The focus should be set on sdada initially | Functional Test

TC-007 | Validate Text Entry and Submission | Enter text in each UI element and submit. Verify if text has been saved properly | Each entered text should be saved correctly, and elements should update accordingly | Functional Test

TC-008 | Test Input Validation (Minimum Characters) | Enter less than the minimum allowed characters (e.g., 1 character for "sdada" element) and verify error message is displayed | Error message should appear when entering less than the minimum required characters | Functional Test

TC-009 | Test Input Validation (Maximum Characters) | Enter more than the maximum allowed characters (e.g., 51 characters for "sdada" element) and verify error message is displayed | Error message should appear when entering more than the maximum allowed characters | Functional Test

TC-010 | Verify UI Behavior on Text Clearance | Clear the text content of each UI element using backspace or delete key and check if elements are empty | Elements should be empty after clearing their content | Functional Test
